name: Add workflow step
description: Append a step that runs a CRM action. `type` is the action's slug (e.g. "tasks.create_task", "email.send_email", "opportunities.update_opportunity") and `config` is that action's parameters. The step executes that action when the workflow runs.

name: Get workflow execution history
description: List recorded execution-log entries for a workflow — one entry per step of each run (empty only for workflows that have never run). Use the workflow__run tool to run one now.
